text: Booked tents, chairs and lighting for my sister's wedding. They came the evening before and had everything ready by morning. Two of their boys stayed till the last guest left.
Gold Chiavari chairs and round tables for 300 people. Clean, no broken pieces, set up exactly as we asked.
Needed a stage and sofa for a Nikah at two days' notice. They sorted it on one phone call.
The flower work on the mandap was beautiful, everyone asked who did it. Pick-up the next day was on time too.
Good sound system and the DJ played what we wanted. Rates were fair for the quality.
We have used Milan Group for our office Diwali function three years running. Pagoda tents, lights and catering counters, all from one place, no running around.
Small pooja at home, only needed chairs and a shamiana. They didn't treat it like a small order.
Calcutta decoration for the haldi was exactly like the photo they showed us on WhatsApp. Would book again.
